title: Qualification state is evidence scoped
summary: The dev6 bundle includes regression suites and a shell driver but there was no usable ooRexx binary in this authoring runtime; zip integrity and static inspection do not establish interpreter pass.
invariants: Inspect the original dev6 VALIDATION.txt before claiming runtime coverage.
Dev1–dev5 regression suites are retained in dev6.
Test adapter emits simulation receipts and cannot be used as evidence of a live provider or external spend.
A GitHub submission marker is not an Autobuild acceptance receipt.
procedure: Run bash tests/run_all.sh /path/to/rexx on installed r13196 or qualified newer interpreter.
Run rexxc on each source file where available.
Check Autobuild result/receipt on main before promoting a candidate.
Perform live provider verification only with approved test accounts and scoped permissions.
